selection: One fixed configuration per algorithm, saved before supplementary execution; no tuning or early stopping; validation labels excluded.
preprocessing: Native numerical columns in frozen schema order; training-only median imputation; all-missing training columns become zero; no scaling.
comparison: 4/class matches the existing Jev demonstration IDs; full training is a separately labeled unequal-data reference. Neither track isolates an LLM+Jev composition effect.
parameter_rationale: 100 trees, learning rate 0.05, depth 3 and L2 regularization 1 are modest fixed choices. Small leaf constraints permit learning with only 8 or 12 labels. The same configuration is used in both training-budget tracks and both datasets.
